description.zh: 自定义任务 ID，用于防止短时间误操作重复请求；3 分钟内，相同自定义任务 ID 的请求只会被处理一次
description.en: Custom task ID. Prevent accidental duplicate requests within a short time. Requests with the same custom task ID are processed only once within three minutes.

description.zh:
扩展信息, JSON String 格式，里面可以包含的字段如下。
- `needEditorData`：取值为字符串 `true`/`false`，默认为`false`，是否需要在结果中返回图片翻译译后编辑器数据，仅用于[自行接入图片翻译译后编辑器](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html)时，获取数据使用
- `ignoreEntityRecognize`：取值为字符串 `true`/`false`，默认为 `false`，电商领域图片翻译会自动判断文字是否在图片中的商品主体上，如果在，则略过翻译；使用本字段来控制是否进行上述判断，本字段对通用图片翻译无效
description.en:
Extended information in JSON string format. Supported fields include the following.

- needEditorData: Set to `true` or `false`. Default is `false`. Set to `true` to return editor data in the response. Use this only when you integrate your own [image translation post-editing editor](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2507676.html).

- ignoreEntityRecognize: Set to `true` or `false`. Default is `false`. For e-commerce image translation, the service automatically detects whether text appears on product entities in the image. If so, it skips translation. Set this field to `true` to disable that detection. This field has no effect on general image translation.

description.zh:
翻译领域， 可选值如下。
- `general`：通用图片翻译
- `e-commerce`：电商领域图片翻译

默认及未识别领域均按通用图片翻译处理。
description.en:
Translation domain. Valid values:

- `general`: General image translation

- `e-commerce`: E-commerce image translation

If not specified or unrecognized, the service uses general image translation.

description.zh: 原图 URL，多张图片使用半角逗号进行分割；单次请求 URL 总数不能超过 20，且相同的 URL 只会被处理一次
description.en: URLs of the source images. Separate multiple URLs with commas. A single request can include up to 20 URLs. Duplicate URLs are processed only once.

description.zh: 源语种，支持的语种及对应的代码请参考[语言code](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
description.en: Source language. For supported languages and their codes, see [language codes](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html).

description.zh: 目标语种，支持的语种及对应的代码请参考[语言code](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html)
description.en: Target language. For supported languages and their codes, see [language codes](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163584.html).

descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解图片翻译产品的[收费方式和价格](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html)。

该接口适用于**通用图片翻译**和**电商图片翻译**；如需调用证件翻译，请参考[证件翻译调用指南](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163527.html)。

**图片限制**

- 文件大小限制：10MB
- 像素限制：长宽比 < 10:1
- 支持的格式：jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, gif（仅翻译第一帧）, webp
descriptions.en:
Before you use this operation, review the [pricing details](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163332.html) for the Image Translation service.

This operation supports **general image translation** and **e-commerce image translation**. For ID document translation, see the [ID document translation guide](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163527.html).

**Image limits**

- File size: up to 10 MB

- Aspect ratio: less than 10:1

- Supported formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, GIF (first frame only), and WebP
